## About
One Concept Automotive is a full-service automotive body shop at 1172 107th St. in Grand Prairie. We handle collision repair, frame repair, paintless dent repair, front end work and custom paint, with the goal of getting your vehicle back to pre-collision quality or better.
We'd rather know you for years than fix your car once. We believe building a personal relationship with each customer makes the whole repair process smoother, and we hope to someday work on your kids' cars too.
We make sure your questions about the repair or the insurance process get answered, so you leave knowing what was done and why. Our customers have rated us 5 on Google from 81 reviews.

## Services
- Full service collision repair: Repairs after an accident, aimed at restoring your vehicle to pre-collision quality or better.
- Custom paint: Custom paint and striping work. One reviewer had a custom purple Tuxedo paint job done on her Jeep Patriot.
- Paintless dent repair: Dent removal without repainting.
- Frame repair: Frame repair alongside our paint and body work.
- Front end and alignment: Front end work and alignment.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my deductible?
A: We'll try to help anyone involved in an accident with deductible assistance so they can get back on the road. Just ask.

Q: How do I get service under the warranty?
A: Bring your vehicle back with our original invoice and we'll take care of the rest.

Q: Are you open Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
